The inline c/v fraction has a visible numerator, fraction bar and denominator, with clear space before and after it. The vector accents and nearby standalone v and c are intact; no collision with neighboring text or lines is visible.

At 390x844, visible vector arrows remain distinct above E and B through the narrower line wrapping. The B near the right content edge remains fully visible, with no horizontal clipping or incoherent overlap.

At 390x844, c/v remains legible with all three fraction components intact and clear inline separation from 'gives' and 'as'. Nearby v and c have coherent spacing; no affected formula-container clipping or overlap is visible.

The existing report records 12 formula wrappers per viewport, no errors and page width equal to viewport width. A local structured read confirms every recorded formula is vertically inside its wrapper and every wrapper horizontally inside its parent at both viewports; screenshot hashes match the report.
Ordinary scrolling prose intersecting the top or bottom viewport edge is a viewport crop, not an affected formula-container defect. No crops or reopens were performed for this review.

limitations: Pixel coverage is restricted to the four named existing screenshots opened once each. Other formula occurrences are covered only by the existing hash-bound DOM bounds evidence, not additional raster inspection.
